entries.title: Live orb + drag carousels + conversation memory
bullets: Built the real animated Loren orb (idle / listening / thinking / speaking) — it now breathes and reacts when you click the ask bar.
Made the tool tiles a proper carousel: drag with the mouse, swipe on a phone, or scroll — same on every device.
Added Loren's conversation memory (two new private tables) so threads persist per user, locked down by row-level security.
Still 100% behind the flag; still nothing existing touched.
entries.bench: 5 files · 2 new tables · additive · reversible · stacked on PR-0

entries.title: Loren has a home behind a safety switch
bullets: Stood up Loren OS at a brand-new page, /loren, that only turns on for us.
Added a master on/off switch (feature flag), off by default.
Built the approved home screen in our brand colors.
Only 2 lines of existing code changed.
entries.bench: 5 files · 1 new table · +2 lines to existing code · 0 existing files modified · ~6 min

entries.title: Design locked: Loren identity, home, and working session
